Antoni Morey <kim...@hotmail.com> wrote:
>My question is if a non-infernal vampire without [dai] or [DAI], uses
>summon history to put into play "infernal servitor"
>what happens then?
>Since he has no [dai] or [DAI] would the text belonging to the
>disciplines be ignored and you would be left with a:
>Unique demon with 2 life, 1 strength, 3 bleed?

If a card requires a discipline and enters play via some other means,
you use the basic version.

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/6c8a3b15f4e25f53

>on another note even though Summon History doesn't specifically state
>it I suppose that you do shuffle your library after using it if you
>search something in it, but do you have to shuffle it if you don't
>search anything in it (if you put something into play from your
>graveyard?

# If an effect causes you to search your library or crypt, shuffle that
deck afterward. [LSJ 20040518]

So if you don't search your library, don't shuffle it.
